chapter: Early career: vaudeville and Kansas City
title: Disputing the 'honky-tonk piano player with a touring vaudeville show' quote
summary: Basie says he would not have used 'honky-tonk' and that it should be a show, not vaudeville, which only had acts.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Now, I'll read what you're saying, okay? "I traveled West from New York with a touring vaudeville show. I was just a kind of honky-tonk piano player with the show." Is that true?
I don't know. It's your words. Is it?
(Inaudible). I don't think I'd use -- I wouldn't have used that word.
"And we had more than our share of troubles."
Everybody got their share of troubles (inaudible).
Right. "We didn't have any names in the cast and we didn't do much business."
Now, what's he talking about, now, a show?
Is he talking about show? I mean, he got to be talking about a show if he mentioned (inaudible).
Yeah, well, I don't know. This is simply you quoted. I'm just reading (inaudible).
Well, we must have been talking about something. It had to be we'd be talking about the show or something like that, if he's saying we didn't have any names in
You know what I mean? He couldn't have meant just the orchestra, you know?
Read it from the top there, where it goes into that.
I'll read it straight. "I was just a kind of honky-tonk piano player with the show and we had more than our share of troubles."
So it was something just before that.
I see. Before that, it just said, "I traveled West from New York with a touring vaudeville show."
"With a show." It shouldn't have said "vaudeville," because vaudeville only had acts. They didn't ever have shows in vaudeville. That was just sort of mixed up there, you know.
I see. You mean, in other words, a show?

With a show, that's where (inaudible) just left. It should have just been with a show, really should have said. Where he put the vaudeville in there, you know, it's just a little twist that he put in there, you know?
